subsystems.name: Data collection layer
subsystems.role: gathers telemetry from networks, endpoints, cloud services and identity systems.

subsystems.name: Normalisation and enrichment
subsystems.role: turns raw events into a common schema with context.

subsystems.name: Baseline modelling
subsystems.role: learns normal behaviour from historical data using unsupervised learning.

subsystems.name: Anomaly detection and scoring
subsystems.role: flags deviations from the baseline and ranks them by risk.

subsystems.name: Investigation and response orchestration
subsystems.role: provides context and automates containment actions.

subsystems.name: Feedback and retraining
subsystems.role: improves models from analyst feedback and new data.

buildSteps.title: Define scope and data sources
buildSteps.detail: Choose which threats to hunt and which logs to collect — network flows, endpoint events, authentication records, cloud audit logs.

buildSteps.title: Ingest and store data
buildSteps.detail: Build pipelines that collect telemetry at scale and store it in a searchable data lake or SIEM.

buildSteps.title: Normalise and enrich
buildSteps.detail: Parse logs into a common schema, add threat intelligence and asset context, and map events to techniques such as MITRE ATT&CK.

buildSteps.title: Engineer features
buildSteps.detail: Create quantitative features from raw events — connection frequency, byte volumes, time-of-day patterns, user-entity relationships.

buildSteps.title: Train baseline models
buildSteps.detail: Use unsupervised learning on months of historical data to model normal behaviour without labelled attacks.

buildSteps.title: Deploy detection and scoring
buildSteps.detail: Run models in production to score anomalies in real time and generate ranked alerts.

buildSteps.title: Integrate with SOC workflows
buildSteps.detail: Connect alerts to case management and SOAR platforms so analysts can triage and respond.

buildSteps.title: Tune with feedback
buildSteps.detail: Collect analyst verdicts, retrain models and adjust thresholds to reduce false positives over time.

prerequisites.why: threat hunting needs months of searchable telemetry to establish baselines and investigate anomalies.
there are few labelled attack examples, so systems must learn normal behaviour from unlabelled data.
context from known adversary techniques helps prioritise anomalies and guide investigation.
endpoint telemetry is a primary data source for detecting host-based compromise.
playbooks can contain simple threats, but full autonomy still requires human oversight.

pathway.milestone: AI-assisted threat hunting in security operations centres
pathway.unlocks: faster detection of novel threats that signature-based tools miss.

pathway.milestone: autonomous agents that investigate and contain low-level threats
pathway.unlocks: reduced analyst workload and faster response to common incidents.

pathway.milestone: federated learning across organisations for privacy-preserving detection
pathway.unlocks: broader visibility of attack patterns without sharing raw sensitive data.

pathway.milestone: self-healing cyber defence systems that respond at machine speed
pathway.unlocks: real-time containment and recovery with minimal human intervention.
